reset_PddlSocialNavTask: reset the PddlSocialNavTask episode and initialize agent navigation start and goal positions
generate_nav_start_goal: generate navigation start and goal positions for the articulated agent in the social nav task
generate_snap_to_obj: snap the target object to the articulated agent hand and return its scene object ID
set_nav_goal_pos: set the navigation goal position property on the PddlSocialNavTask instance
get_initial_robot_trans: get the initial robot base transformation matrix from the PddlSocialNavTask instance
